description: A utility class providing methods for keyword processing, including tokenization, stemming, stop word filtering, and keyword expansion based on thesaurus relationships, used in keyword search functionality within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: KeywordSearchUtil
classes.description: Final utility class with static methods for keyword processing, including tokenization, stemming, stop word filtering, and thesaurus-based expansion.

methods.name: getSeparators
methods.description: Retrieves the string of separator characters used for tokenizing keywords.

methods.name: getStopWordBagOr
methods.description: Retrieves the stop word bag for OR conditions.

methods.name: getStopWordBagAnd
methods.description: Retrieves the stop word bag for AND conditions.

methods.name: getRemoveStems
methods.description: Determines whether stemming should be removed based on configuration.

methods.name: getStemSet
methods.description: Returns a set of stem suffixes used for stemming tokens.

methods.name: processForKeywords
methods.description: Processes input string into keywords, applying tokenization, stop word filtering, stemming, and prefix/suffix wildcards.

methods.name: processKeywordsForIndex
methods.description: Processes input string into keywords for indexing, with specific parameters.

methods.name: fixupKeywordSet
methods.description: Cleans and filters a set of keywords, applying stop word filtering, stemming, and wildcard processing.

methods.name: makeKeywordSet
methods.description: Tokenizes a string into a set of keywords based on separators, with optional search-specific modifications.

methods.name: fixKeywordsForSearch
methods.description: Adjusts a set of keywords for search, applying stemming and wildcards.

methods.name: expandKeywordForSearch
methods.description: Expands an entered keyword using thesaurus relationships from the database, possibly replacing the original keyword.
